title: This Girl, That Girl, and the Other One

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days after Matikanetannhauser's debut…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer! SOS! Mayday!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uh… Well, it's… Just turn on the TV!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I do as she says and fumble the TV on to find…

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: We're interviewing Umamusume who debuted this year! Today, we're featuring someone who showed amazing skill in her debut race—Mihono Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Bourbon's really running on TV!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wow, I mean I heard she got interviewed, but isn't this cool?! And I debuted around the same time as her! I'm so proud of her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: People at Chukyo Racecourse, where Mihono Bourbon made her debut, are raving about her talent.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: She had a late start, but got all the way to first on that straight! It seriously sent shivers down my spine!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Her legs seem so strong. I'm sure she'll just keep getting better and better.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: You're the big new star of the season! Could you tell us exactly what your goals are for the Twinkle Series?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My only goal is to win the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see! Not to be rude, but that's rather surprising to hear. I thought you would be more interested in sprints…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I may be more suited for sprints, but that does not matter. My goal is the Triple Crown and my decision is final.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Wow…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon declares her goal calmly and confidently in front of the camera.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That was so cool! Bourbon really is something else!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh. But if she's on the Triple Crown Tour, that means we'll be racing each other, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh my!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, the same show is playing on the TV in the dorm lobby.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Next up, we'll be covering Umamusume in their classic and senior years!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I bet I know which two they'll talk about.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: One has been hailed as the strongest stayer around—Mejiro McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: And the other is the prodigy who's yet to lose a race, including both the Japanese Derby and the Satsuki Sho—Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hah. Sure enough…

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: We've got all of the A-listers here! I hope we get a chance to see them clash someday.

text_block_list.name: Racing Expert
text_block_list.text: Agreed. However, Tokai Teio's injury directly following the Derby was most unfortunate.

text_block_list.name: Racing Expert
text_block_list.text: I believe they said it will take her about six months to recover and that she won't be running in the Kikuka Sho. It's a shame because the Triple Crown would have been a sure thing.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: That's right. Many people were hoping to see a new Triple Crown champion. I'm personally also disappointed she won't be running.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If she could run, it would've been a sure thing…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Yeah… That's probably true…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Muuun! I ran my heart out today! Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh. Is that… Nature over there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow Matikanetannhauser's gaze to find Nice Nature gazing at the track with a gloomy expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well… She's actually been like that for a few days now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I'm a bit worried…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go talk to her real quick!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Let me guess. You're feeling a bit blue because you drew a modest fortune today?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But it's okay! The name of today's lucky Uma starts with "M" and ends with "R." If you talk to her, you'll be happy again in no time!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: U-um… I'm just pretending to be Fuku!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: For a limited time only, this lucky Umamusume is willing to hear out any problem.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Just trying to lighten the mood.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pffft! That's so—what the heck?! Haha.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Thanks for the laugh. And sorry for worrying you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But would an Umamusume whose name starts with "M" and ends with "R" actually be willing to listen to me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The thing is… I've wanted to run in the Kikuka Sho for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Originally, it was Tokai Teio who made me want to enter. I figured I'd give it a try and got really into my training.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But then I saw that segment on how upset everyone was about the fact that Teio isn't running in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You know how that expert said the Triple Crown would've been a sure thing for her if she ran? I couldn't believe they said something like that!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm sure Teio knows that better than anyone! But she can't run.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ever since she was little, she had her heart set on being the invincible Triple Crown champion. She worked so hard for it, and now it's impossible!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even though she's probably feeling crushed, all these people are saying irresponsible stuff like that about her… It's gotta be tough… it has to be.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …And on top of that, whoever does end up winning the Kikuka Sho will probably have to hear that drivel too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: People will say she only won because Teio wasn't there.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Just for argument's sake, let's say that I won for example. I'm sure I'd be ecstatic.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But there'd always be this footnote saying it was because Teio wasn't there…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haha. I can't believe I'm saying this before I even run. But my mind just keeps wandering to all this pointless stuff…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I'm so lame!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I should be putting everything I've got into training right now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser gazes kindly at Nice Nature as she hangs her head.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What would you do in this situation, Tannhauser?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm… Well… I think I'd be thinking the same thing you are.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I mean, that would bother anyone. I'm sure I'd mull it over too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But despite all of that, I think there would always be some part of me that just simply wanted to win the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So… Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You just have to win so convincingly that no one will even compare you to Teio.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I think that's your only option! You gotta win by a landslide…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So that everyone forgets about Teio completely!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uh… Did you hear what I said?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence falls over them suddenly. The two of them stare at each other, until…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hah! Haha, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Did I say something funny?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Geez! I should've known—that's exactly the kind of person you are… But thanks, you've given me exactly the wake-up call I needed.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I've gotta keep my head up and keep moving forward. I'm not gonna get anywhere moping around like this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. I'm gonna win. It's going to be a blowout. It's totally possible.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure exactly what's going on, but you feel better, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, definitely… Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pheeew! All riiiight! So how about it? Wanna run into the setting sun?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haha! Not a chance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them joke around while they walk back to the academy together. The sun may be setting, but Nice Nature seems a little brighter.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "Even if you don't shine as bright as the sun, you've got a weapon no one else has! You have the power to take someone's hand and give them the push they need!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel like I almost can hear Director Akikawa's words from that day ringing in the air.
